t: You're looking at Whittington Hospital in Archway, a district general and teaching hospital run by Whittington Health for Islington and Haringey. Its Jenner Building, a former smallpox hospital, is Grade II listed. The name comes from Richard Whittington, four times Lord Mayor of London, who paid for drainage in poor parts of the city and a hospital ward for unmarried mothers. His charity still helps people today. The politician David Lammy was born here and has been MP for Tottenham since 2000. Suffragette Theresa Garnett, comedian Sean Hughes, bird conservationist Phyllis Barclay-Smith and New Scientist founder Tom Margerison all died here.
